events.text: Snowmelt swells the rivers. Villages below the dam are at risk.

effects.log: Days of mud and sandbags. The water holds.
They move to higher ground in time.

ok.log: A wall of backs and sandbags. It holds until the engineers come.

fail.log: It breaks. You drag three people out of the water.

effects.log: Every child reaches the hill.

events.text: The roads are rivers of mud. Carts are stuck everywhere.

effects.log: A mud-covered hero.
A week of reading.

events.text: The first green shoots push up through melting snow.

effects.log: By summer, a row of beans with your name on it.
Something in you wakes too.

events.text: You remember a promise: a Kunlun monk told you to come back when the snow melted.

effects.log: He is waiting. He teaches you one thing: how to breathe through cold and fear.
He replies with one line: "The door is always open."

events.text: A hungry bear wakes early and wanders into a farm.

ok.log: It goes back to the woods.

choices.text: Leave honey at the forest edge

effects.log: It follows the honey away.

events.text: The river ice breaks up with a roar like thunder.

effects.log: The whole river moving at once.
The first crossing of spring. They give you a free ride.

events.text: Farmers need seed money for spring planting. The moneylenders smell profit.

choices.text: Lend a farmer some silver, interest free

effects.log: He repays you at harvest with a bag of rice. (−10 taels)

choices.text: Organise the village to share seed

effects.log: Nobody needs the moneylender this year.

events.text: The snowmelt makes a hundred little rivers in the lane.

effects.log: You are the chief engineer of the lane.
A whole fleet.

events.text: The melting snow reveals a cave entrance that was hidden all winter.

ok.log: A hermit's abandoned winter stores: dried herbs and a jar of coins. (+10 taels)

choices.text: Mark it and come back later

effects.log: You never find it again.

variants: The spring thaw has uncovered the mouth of a cave that the snow hid all winter.

events.text: Two proud swordsmen insist on a duel in the mud.

effects.log: Both fall in the mud. It is a draw, you declare.
Terrible swordsmanship, great comedy.

events.text: The mountain passes open. Travellers set out again.

effects.log: Spring air and new places.
A quiet spring of progress.
